```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
pio.renderers.default = "iframe"

df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\subha\Downloads\UserLvl.csv")

df.columns = df.columns.str.lower()

df["secs_firstview_to_firstpurchase"] = pd.to_numeric(df["secs_firstview_to_firstpurchase"], errors = "coerce")

df['secs_firstcart_to_firstpurchase'] = pd.to_numeric(df['secs_firstcart_to_firstpurchase'], errors = 'coerce')

df['lifetime_revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['lifetime_revenue'],errors='coerce')

# for all the date and time

ts_cols = ['first_event_time','last_event_time','first_view_time','first_cart_time','first_purchase_time','latest_order_date']

for i in ts_cols:
  if i in df.columns:
    df[i]=pd.to_datetime(df[i],errors='coerce')

df['view_to_purchase_hours'] = df['secs_firstview_to_firstpurchase'] / 3600
df['cart_to_purchase_hours'] = df['secs_firstcart_to_firstpurchase'] / 3600
total_users = df['user_id'].count()

converted_users = df['is_converted'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('yes').sum()

conversion_percentage = converted_users / total_users

avg_rev_per_conv_user = df.loc[(df['is_converted'].str.lower()=='yes')&(df['lifetime_revenue'] > 0),'lifetime_revenue'].astype(float).mean()

avg_time_per_conversion = df.loc[df['is_converted'].str.lower()=='yes','secs_firstview_to_firstpurchase'].astype(float).mean() / 3600

conv_pct_display = round(conversion_percentage* 100 , 2)
avg_rev_display = round(avg_rev_per_conv_user,2)
avg_time_display = round(avg_time_per_conversion,2)

```


```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
fig = go.Figure()

kpis = [
    ("Total Users", total_users, ",", "", ""),
    ("Converted", converted_users, ",", "", ""),
    ("Conversion", conv_pct_display, ".2f", "", "%"),
    ("Avg Revenue", avg_rev_display, ",.2f", "$", ""),
    ("Avg Time", avg_time_display, ".1f", "", " hrs"),
]

n = len(kpis)
padding = 0.01  

for i, (title, value, fmt, prefix, suffix) in enumerate(kpis):
    x_start = i/n + padding
    x_end = (i+1)/n - padding
    
    fig.add_trace(go.Indicator(
        mode="number",
        value=value,
        title={"text": title, "font": {"size": 14}},
        number={
            "valueformat": fmt,
            "prefix": prefix,
            "suffix": suffix,
            "font": {"size": 34}
        },
        domain={"x": [x_start, x_end], "y": [0, 1]}
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    height=200,
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20),
    template="plotly_white"
)
```

users_viewed = df['first_view_time'].count()

```{python}
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

df["view_to_purchase_hrs"] = pd.to_numeric(df.get("secs_firstview_to_firstpurchase"), errors="coerce") / 3600
df["cart_to_purchase_hrs"] = pd.to_numeric(df.get("secs_firstcart_to_firstpurchase"), errors="coerce") / 3600

fig_subplots = make_subplots(
    rows=1, cols=2,
    subplot_titles=(
        'View → Purchase Time Distribution',
        'Cart → Purchase Time Distribution'
    ),
    horizontal_spacing=0.10
)

view_data = df['view_to_purchase_hrs'].dropna()
cart_data = df['cart_to_purchase_hrs'].dropna()

fig_subplots.add_trace(
    go.Histogram(
        x=view_data,
        nbinsx=100,
        name='View → Purchase',
        marker_color="#4C78A8",
        hovertemplate='Hours: %{x:.1f}<br>Count: %{y:,}<extra></extra>'
    ), 
    row=1, col=1
)

fig_subplots.add_trace(
    go.Histogram(
        x=cart_data,
        nbinsx=100,
        name='Cart → Purchase',
        marker_color="#F58518",
        hovertemplate='Hours: %{x:.1f}<br>Count: %{y:,}<extra></extra>'
    ),
    row=1, col=2
)

view_max = view_data.max()
cart_max = cart_data.max()

def get_tick_interval(max_val):
    if max_val <= 100:
        return 12
    elif max_val <= 500:
        return 24
    elif max_val <= 1000:
        return 48
    else:
        return 168

view_tick = get_tick_interval(view_max)
cart_tick = get_tick_interval(cart_max)

fig_subplots.update_xaxes(
    title_text='Hours',
    row=1, col=1,
    dtick=view_tick,
    tickmode='linear',
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor='lightgray'
)

fig_subplots.update_xaxes(
    title_text='Hours',
    row=1, col=2,
    dtick=cart_tick,
    tickmode='linear',
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor='lightgray'
)

fig_subplots.update_yaxes(
    title_text='Count',
    row=1, col=1,
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor='lightgray'
)

fig_subplots.update_yaxes(
    title_text='Count',
    row=1, col=2,
    showgrid=True,
    gridcolor='lightgray'
)

fig_subplots.update_layout(
    height=500,
    showlegend=False,
    title={
        'text': 'Conversion Time Analysis',
        'x': 0.5,
        'xanchor': 'center',
        'font': {'size': 22}
    },
    template='plotly_white',
    margin=dict(l=70, r=70, t=100, b=80)
)
```

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

df['last_event_time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['last_event_time'],errors = 'coerce')
today = df['last_event_time'].max()
df['days_since_last_active'] = (today - df['last_event_time']).dt.days

bins = [-1,7,30,90,180]
labels = ['Active (0-7)','Warm (8-30)','At Risk (31-90)','Dormant (91-180)']

df['dormancy_segment'] = pd.cut(
  df['days_since_last_active'],
  bins=bins,
  labels = labels
)

dormancy_counts = (
  df.groupby('dormancy_segment')['user_id']
  .nunique()
  .reset_index(name='users')
)

dormancy_counts['dormancy_segment'] = pd.Categorical(
  dormancy_counts['dormancy_segment'],
  categories = labels,
  ordered = True
)

dormancy_counts = dormancy_counts.sort_values('dormancy_segment')

fig_dormancy = px.bar(
  dormancy_counts,
  x='dormancy_segment',
  y='users',
  color='dormancy_segment',
  color_discrete_sequence=["#2ca02c", "#8bc34a", "#ffc107", "#ff9800"],
  text = dormancy_counts['users'].map(lambda x: f'{x:,}'),
  title= 'Dormancy Segmentation Of Users'
)

fig_dormancy.update_traces(textposition='outside')
fig_dormancy.update_layout(
  xaxis_title ='Dormancy Segment',
  yaxis_title = 'Number Of Users',
  showlegend = False,
  height = 380,
  margin= dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40),
  template = 'plotly_white'
)
```
